title: Go Beginner Mock Test 1
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for Go at beginner level.

questions.prompt: Which statement accurately describes modules in Go?

options.text: modules define an import path and dependency boundary
initialize and commit go.mod
changing module identity breaks import assumptions
The runtime automatically repairs the program

questions.explanation: modules define an import path and dependency boundary. Confirm with gofmt, go test, and a focused program.
